The Department: Marketing

The Role: Content Production Intern

We’re looking for a Content Production Intern to help bring our social engine to life. You’ll work alongside the marketing & product team to brainstorm ideas, spot opportunities, and help produce content across our social channels, getting hands on experience with everything from creative development and production to launches and social strategy. We’re looking for someone who’s curious, plugged into the internet, has that dog in them, and is excited to learn by making things.

This will be a semester long internship program with 3 days a week in person at our New York City, NY office from January to April 2027.

Responsibilities

  • Edit guest segment recordings into podcast episodes formatted for Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and YouTube
  • Clip 2-3 moments per stream for use on X
  • Sit in the stream room during live broadcasts as a live producer, spotting standout moments in real time and clipping them
  • Run live stream graphics and on screen elements during the broadcast
  • Track trends, internet culture, and industry news to help pitch stream titles and topics
  • Collaborate with the social team on distribution strategy for each piece of content once it's produced

Qualifications

  • Pursuing an associate's, bachelor's, or master's degree in any relevant field
  • Genuine interest in media production, livestreaming, and internet culture
  • Working knowledge of video editing tools (Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci, etc.)

  • An eye for what makes a moment clips and text engaging
  • Organized enough to manage multiple deliverables (podcast cut, clips, graphics) from a single stream
  • Has that dog in them
  • Genuine interest in finance, crypto, and prediction markets is a plus

Who are we?

FalconX is a pioneering team of operators, investors, and builders committed to revolutionizing institutional access to the crypto markets. Operating at the intersection of traditional finance and  cutting-edge technology, FalconX addresses the industry's foremost challenges: Navigating the digital asset market can be complex and fragmented, with limited products and services that support trading strategies, structures, and liquidity found in conventional financial markets. As a comprehensive solution for all digital asset strategies from start to scale, FalconX operates as the connective tissue empowering clients with seamless navigation through the ever- evolving cryptocurrency landscape.

About the role

FalconX is a digital asset prime brokerage serving institutional clients across multiple jurisdictions. Our legal function supports trading documentation, regulatory obligations, licensing, entity governance and corporate matters.

We’re hiring an Associate, Legal Operations to make our Legal department an AI-native function. You’ll build AI and automation into real legal matters, strengthen the knowledge and processes behind them, and automate the repetitive work that today consumes counsel time.

You'll start with a legal AI platform already live on matters, agentic development tools, and a team committed to deep AI implementation. You’ll own projects from discovery through implementation and adoption. The goal: enable faster delivery, reduce repetitive work, improve service quality and give counsel more time for legal judgment then expanding the use case into other areas of the firm.

What you will do

AI-native legal delivery

  • Redesign how legal work gets done. Eliminate unnecessary steps, build counsel-approved self-service paths and clarify ownership across teams. Prioritize improvements by impact, risk and effort.
  • Build and deploy AI workflows for drafting, playbook-based review, regulatory research and regulator correspondence, all in partnership with counsel.
  • Select additional tools where needed. Work with IT, Security and vendors on integrations and technical dependencies
  • Own rollout and adoption. Test with users, train teams, document workflows and improve what you ship
  • Establish evaluation, confidentiality, access controls and human-review standards with counsel and Security
  • Measure turnaround times, manual effort, errors, adoption and user experience. Use results to prioritize improvements

Legal knowledge as infrastructure

  • Structure contracts, entity data, obligations, templates, playbooks and precedents for reliable search and AI use
  • Establish ownership and maintenance processes to keep legal information accurate, current and appropriately accessible
  • Make obligations, deadlines and entity information easy for Legal and authorized business teams to find and act on

Operating backbone

  • Run intake, triage and routing so every request has a clear owner, status and path to resolution
  • Own outside counsel management, the entity filings calendar, and signature and execution workflows
  • Track repetitive work, remove unnecessary steps and automate routine tasks while keeping operations dependable

Who you are

  • A builder with legal judgment. You’ve shipped AI or automation into a legal or adjacent function and can show what you built, how you drove adoption and what improved
  • Hands-on with technology. You configure platforms, work with APIs and light scripting, and build practical solutions with the resources available
  • Fluent in legal workflows. You understand where AI adds value, where human review matters and when counsel must be involved
  • An effective operator. You communicate simply, listen to users and deliver projects despite imperfect data and competing priorities
  • Experience in fintech, crypto, financial services or another regulated environment is a strong plus. A law degree or traditional legal ops career path is a plus but not required. We care about what you’ve built
  • 2–5 years of relevant experience in engineering, automation or technical operations, with demonstrated delivery of AI-enabled workflows.

What success looks like

Counsel spends more time on judgment and less on repetitive work. Routine requests follow approved self-service paths, with clear escalation when needed. Contracts, obligations and precedents are structured and easy to find. Business teams know how to engage Legal and what to expect. Improvements show up in faster turnaround, less manual effort and reliable service. Legal becomes a model for AI adoption across FalconX.

The base pay for this role is expected to be between $98,000 - $124,000 in New York City. This expected base pay range is based on information at the time this post was generated. This role will also be eligible for other forms of compensation such as a performance linked bonus, equity, and a competitive benefits package. Actual compensation for a successful candidate will be determined based on a number of factors such as location, skillset, experience, qualifications and the level at which the candidate is hired.

descriptions.job-0u1r8cw:
At Breeze, we're building the AI-powered infrastructure layer for global commerce, making it radically simpler for businesses to sell, get paid, and operate across markets.

We go far beyond traditional payment processing. Breeze combines global payments, AI, stablecoins, and a Merchant of Record-like model to take on the complexity businesses typically manage themselves, including compliance, risk, fraud, chargebacks, reconciliation, and customer support.

Our goal is simple: let businesses focus on building and selling great products while Breeze handles the complexity behind getting paid.

Backed by Sequoia Capital, Multicoin Capital, and The Chainsmokers, Breeze is a successful, rapidly growing, and exceptionally well-capitalized company. We have the runway to think long term while remaining early enough that every person joining today can have a meaningful impact on what we build.

We are hiring a Business Development Representative!

As our Business Development Representative, reporting to our Head of Sales, you'll own the top of the funnel: identifying the companies that should be running on Breeze, getting through to the people who actually make the decision, and turning cold accounts into conversations our sales team can close.

This is an execution role with real judgment attached. You'll build target lists from scratch, work accounts across email, LinkedIn, phone, and wherever else your buyers pay attention, and write outreach that earns a reply from operators who get pitched by a payments company every week of their lives. It's also a build role. Outbound at Breeze is still early, and the targeting, sequences, and messaging you prove out become the playbook the next set of hires runs.

We're looking for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, wants meaningful ownership, and is excited to build rather than simply maintain.

What You'll Do

Pipeline generation

  • Own outbound pipeline for your territory and hit weekly and monthly meeting targets.
  • Run high-volume, multi-channel outbound across email, LinkedIn, phone, and other channels where your buyers are reachable.
  • Qualify inbound and outbound interest against our ICP, and hand off meetings with enough context that the account executive can run the first call properly.
  • Manage multi-touch sequences and persistent follow-up across long buying cycles.

Research and targeting

  • Build and maintain target account lists: who they are, what they sell, how they take payments today, and why Breeze is a better answer.
  • Map buying committees and find the person who actually owns the payments decision, not just the person who is easiest to reach.
  • Use data and account research to prioritize the accounts most likely to convert.

Messaging and experimentation

  • Write outreach that is specific to the account and worth reading, not templated filler.
  • Run structured experiments on subject lines, angles, channels, and sequencing, and keep what works.
  • Feed what you're hearing in the market back to sales and marketing so our messaging keeps getting sharper.

Systems and reporting

  • Keep CRM and outbound tooling clean and current: activity, accounts, contacts, and opportunity stages.
  • Track your own funnel metrics and know where your conversion is breaking down before anyone has to ask.
  • Use AI and automation to remove the repetitive work from research, list building, and personalization.

What We're Looking For

  • 1–3+ years in sales development, business development, or outbound prospecting, with a track record of hitting meeting or pipeline targets.
  • Demonstrated comfort with high-volume outbound across multiple channels, including phone.
  • Strong written communication. You can hold a stranger's attention in four sentences and make a specific, credible case.
  • Genuine persistence and organization. You run dozens of accounts in parallel without letting follow-ups slip.
  • Hands-on with CRM and sales engagement tooling (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, SalesLoft, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or equivalents).
  • Enough commercial curiosity to learn how payments actually work and explain it plainly to a prospect.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving environments without an established playbook.
  • A builder mentality with a strong bias toward action.
  • Excited to use AI and automation to work smarter and rethink existing processes.
  • Comfortable getting into the details and doing the work, regardless of seniority.

Nice to Have

  • Experience prospecting into fintech, payments, ecommerce, gaming, or other high-volume digital commerce verticals.
  • Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup, especially as an early outbound hire.
  • Ability to pull and analyze your own outbound data rather than waiting on a report.
  • Experience building a sequence or territory from zero.

What Success Looks Like

  • 30 days: You know the product, the ICP, and the competitive landscape well enough to run your own outreach. Your first sequences are live.
  • 90 days: You're consistently hitting your meeting targets, your handoffs are clean, and you have evidence on which messages and segments work.
  • 6 months: You've built a repeatable outbound motion in your territory that another rep could pick up and run, and you're a real input into how we target and position Breeze.

Why Breeze

  • More than payments: We're building an intelligent infrastructure layer across payments, compliance, risk, fraud, chargebacks, reconciliation, and customer support.
  • AI from the ground up: AI isn't an add-on. It's central to how we're building our products and how our teams operate.
  • Successful and still early: We have meaningful traction and strong financial foundations while remaining early enough for new hires to have outsized impact.
  • Built for the long term: Backed by Sequoia Capital, Multicoin Capital, and The Chainsmokers, we're exceptionally well-capitalized with the runway to think big.
  • Real ownership: Lean teams, few layers, direct access to decision-makers, and the autonomy to make things happen.
  • Hard problems: Work at the intersection of AI, payments, stablecoins, risk, compliance, financial infrastructure, and global commerce.
  • Exceptional team: Work with ambitious, curious, low-ego people who move quickly and care deeply about what they build.
  • Room to grow: As Breeze grows, strong performers can quickly expand their scope and take on bigger problems.

How We Work

  • Act Now, Improve Later: Ship something real today. Move fast, learn from what happens, and make it better.
  • Disagree and Commit: Debate hard before a decision. Once it's made, commit fully and make the outcome right.
  • Customers First: When in doubt, start with what's most painful for the customer.
  • Own It, End to End: Don't wait to be asked. If you see a problem, take responsibility for solving it.
  • Default to Public: Share context openly so the whole team can move faster and learn from each other.
  • High Standards, Genuine Warmth: Hold the bar high and treat people well. Be direct, rigorous, kind, and low ego.
  • Outcomes Over Activity: We care about what ships, what works, and what moves the needle, not how busy you look.
  • AI Forward, Always Learning: Experiment with new tools, automate the repetitive, share what works, and continuously rethink how you can work smarter.

Compensation Philosophy

We believe compensation should be fair, competitive, consistent, and transparent.

  • We benchmark compensation against the market and establish thoughtful bands for each role.
  • Compensation reflects experience, skills, location, role scope, and expected impact.
  • We don't believe pay should primarily depend on how aggressively someone negotiates.
  • Eligible employees receive meaningful equity, so the people building Breeze can participate in the long-term value they help create.

Benefits & Perks

  • Health coverage: Breeze covers 100% of employee premiums on our competitive base plan and 75% of dependent premiums.
  • PTO: 21 days, plus applicable company holidays.
  • 401(k): Breeze covers all plan administration fees.
  • Equity: Meaningful ownership in the company you're helping build.
  • Equipment: A new MacBook Air and whatever else you need to do your best work.
  • Office & education allowance: An annual budget for your workspace, tools, and professional development.
  • Wellness: A monthly reimbursement to support your well-being.
  • Annual global offsite: We bring the global Breeze team together every year. Previous destinations include Bali and Singapore, with Japan coming next.

Why Join Breeze

  • Make an outsized impact: We're successful and still early, with meaningful traction and strong financial foundations. Lean teams, few layers, and direct access to decision-makers mean you'll have real ownership and the autonomy to make things happen.
  • Solve hard, meaningful problems: Work at the intersection of AI, payments, stablecoins, risk, compliance, financial infrastructure, and global commerce as we build an intelligent infrastructure layer that goes far beyond payments.
  • Build AI-first: AI isn't an add-on. It's central to how we're building our products and how our teams operate. You'll experiment with new tools, automate the repetitive, and continuously rethink how to work smarter.
  • Work with an exceptional team: Join ambitious, curious, low-ego people who move quickly, hold a high bar, and care deeply about what they build.
  • Grow with Breeze: As Breeze grows, strong performers can quickly expand their scope and take on bigger problems.
  • Build for the long term: Backed by Sequoia Capital, Multicoin Capital, and The Chainsmokers, we're exceptionally well-capitalized with the runway to think big.

In-Office Expectations

Employees based in our New York City, NY office follow a hybrid work model and are expected to work from the office three days per week. Employees based in our Singapore office are expected to work on-site five days per week.

In-office expectations may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process.

Our approach is designed to support meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making while providing flexibility where applicable. We believe this structure enables strong execution, close collaboration, and effective teamwork across our global offices.

Come Build With Us!

We offer a rare combination: the ownership and speed of an early-stage company with the traction, backing, and financial foundations of a successful business.

We're building at the convergence of AI, payments, stablecoins, financial infrastructure, and global commerce. The opportunity is much bigger than building another payment processor.

We're building the intelligent infrastructure layer for global commerce, and there's still an enormous amount left to build.

If you want meaningful ownership, hard problems, exceptional teammates, and the opportunity to help define what comes next, we'd love to hear from you!

It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

The North American Enterprise team drives growth across our commerce and payments portfolio, including Afterpay and Cash App Pay. We partner with leading global brands to help them reach the next generation of consumers, create more flexible commerce experiences, and deliver measurable business results.
We are looking for an experienced enterprise seller to build and expand Block’s relationships with some of the world’s largest brands. You will identify new revenue opportunities, develop relationships with senior executives, and lead complex, often first-of-their-kind partnerships from initial strategy through negotiation, launch, and growth.

This role sits at the intersection of commerce, payments, technology, and consumer behavior. You will work closely with decision-makers across payments, marketing, digital commerce, finance, and technology while bringing together internal partners across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Risk, Marketing, and Operations.
You will thrive in this role if you combine strong commercial instincts with strategic thinking, disciplined execution, and the ability to navigate ambiguity. Success requires persistence through long, multifaceted sales cycles, sound judgment, and the ability to create alignment across complex organizations.

You Will

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle, from account strategy and opportunity creation through negotiation, contracting, launch, and expansion.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior executives at leading global brands and position Block as a strategic partner in commerce and payments.
  • Develop compelling, insight-led sales narratives that connect Cash App and Afterpay’s capabilities to each prospective partner’s priorities, customers, and growth strategy.
  • Lead complex and often first-of-their-kind deals using clear milestones, success measures, stakeholder alignment, and disciplined deal management.
  • Create thoughtful commercial strategies and negotiate pragmatic, mutually beneficial agreements informed by data, financial analysis, and business principles.
  • Coordinate cross-functional deal teams across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Risk, and Operations.
  • Translate merchant needs and market insights into actionable feedback that helps shape Block’s product and go-to-market strategy.
  • Build Block’s enterprise network by developing relationships across target accounts and representing Cash App and Afterpay at industry events and executive forums.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the payments and commerce landscape, including emerging technologies, consumer trends, and competitive dynamics.
  • Consistently deliver against ambitious revenue goals while building a durable pipeline of strategic opportunities.

You Have

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise sales, business development, partnerships, go-to-market strategy, or a related commercial role, ideally within technology, payments, financial services, or another high-growth environment.
  • Experience owning enterprise opportunities from initial prospecting and account planning through negotiation, contracting, launch, and expansion.
  • A demonstrated record of meeting or exceeding individual revenue or sales targets.
  • Experience closing enterprise agreements with extended sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Experience developing account strategies and creating new revenue opportunities within large or global organizations.
  • Experience presenting commercial recommendations, proposals, and business cases to senior executives, including C-suite decision-makers.
  • Experience negotiating pricing, financial terms, commercial contracts, or other complex deal structures in partnership with Finance and Legal teams.
  • Experience using customer, market, revenue, and financial data to develop business cases and inform deal strategy.
  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams during technical discovery, solution development, product scoping, or integration planning.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams across functions such as Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Risk, Marketing, and Operations.
  • Experience managing sales forecasts, pipeline activity, and deal progress against defined milestones and performance targets.
  • Experience translating technical and commercial concepts for both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Familiarity with payments, financial technology, digital commerce, or consumer technology.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.

Senior Solutions Engineer, API & Developer Platform

Location: Remote (USA and Europe)

Employment Type: Full-time

Team: Business Development

About Brave

Brave is building the independent search infrastructure for the AI era.While others wrap Bing or Google APIs, we own our own global web index. This allows us to offer what Big Tech cannot: Zero-Data-Retention (ZDR) guarantees, unbiased ranking, and total sovereignty.

Our Search API is currently powering the next generation of LLMs, RAG pipelines, and agentic frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.). We are looking for a hybrid Product Marketer and Developer Advocate to own the GTM strategy for this platform.

You will bridge the gap between our engineering team and the developer market. You will not just market the product; you will demonstrate how to build with it.

Role Overview

This is a technical sales role for Brave Search API.

We need someone who can work directly with prospective customers and help them understand whether Brave Search API is the right fit for what they are building. That means running demos, answering technical questions, helping with early integrations, building small proof-of-concepts, and giving Product and Engineering clear feedback on what customers are asking for.

This is not a pure marketing role and it is not a community-only DevRel role. The work is closer to solutions engineering, but with enough developer-facing content and example code to help people get started without a lot of hand-holding.

You should be comfortable talking to developers, founders, technical buyers, and internal teams, and be able to build credible examples using the product.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support technical sales conversations: Join customer and partner calls, help with technical discovery, answer product questions, and explain how Brave Search API can fit into different products and AI workflows.
  • Run demos and build proof-of-concepts: Create demos, small apps, notebooks, and examples that show how to use Brave Search API for search, RAG, LLM apps, agents, and other use cases customers care about.
  • Help customers get started: Work with prospects and customers as they move from first API call to a working integration. Identify where they get stuck and help remove those blockers.
  • Improve sales and onboarding materials: Create and maintain technical guides, demo scripts, sample code, integration notes, FAQs, and comparison materials that help customers evaluate the product.
  • Work with Product and Engineering: Bring back clear feedback from customers, including missing features, confusing docs, common implementation issues, pricing questions, and competitive gaps.
  • Improve the developer experience: Help make the docs, examples, API onboarding, and setup flow easier to use. The goal is to make it simple for a developer to test Brave Search API and understand what they can build with it.
  • Support integrations: Help Brave show up well in the tools AI developers already use, such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vercel AI SDK, and similar frameworks.
  • Support launches: Work with Product Marketing when needed, mostly by providing the technical pieces: demos, docs, examples, and clear explanations of what changed.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Technical sales experience: You have worked with prospects, customers, partners, or technical buyers before. You know how to ask good questions, understand what someone is trying to build, and explain whether the product can help.
  • Hands-on technical ability: You can read and write basic Python or JavaScript, test an API with cURL or Postman, and build simple examples without needing an engineer to do it for you.
  • AI and search knowledge: You understand RAG, LLMs, agents, context windows, search APIs, and the difference between lexical and semantic search.
  • Developer credibility: You know what makes APIs frustrating to use. You care about docs, rate limits, examples, error messages, and how long it takes someone to get their first successful API call.
  • Clear communication: You can explain technical ideas in plain language. You can write docs, customer notes, demo scripts, and short technical explainers that do not sound like marketing copy.
  • Good internal follow-through: You can take what customers are saying and turn it into useful feedback for Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in sales engineering, solutions engineering, developer platforms, API products, search infrastructure, AI tools, or data products.
  • Experience working at or with developer-focused companies such as Vercel, Supabase, Stripe, HashiCorp, LangChain, or similar companies.
  • Existing familiarity with the AI builder ecosystem.
  • Experience helping customers move from evaluation to production.

Why Brave?

  • Real Tech, No Slideware: We aren't selling a wrapper. We have our own crawlers, index, and serving stack.
  • David vs. Goliath: We are the only viable alternative to the Big Tech search monopoly. The market needs us to win.
  •  High Impact: You will be the primary voice for a product used by millions of users and thousands of developers.
  • Privacy First: We prove that you don't need to harvest user data to build a world-class business. 

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to drive developer growth for a cutting-edge API product in a high-growth company.
  • Remote flexibility with a collaborative, results-oriented culture.
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and professional development opportunities.
  • Compensation in the United States is $150,000.00 to $200,000.00 DOE

How to Apply

Send your resume, GitHub profile, and one specific example of a technical product you helped bring to market (a blog post, a demo, a launch strategy, or a docs page).

Brave is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

About the Role

The overnight Transaction Reporting Analyst is a critical role responsible for the operational integrity of DriveWealth's regulatory trade reporting during the newly extended 24/5 equity trading session. This role owns the overnight monitoring, exception handling, and repair of trade reporting submissions to FINRA's Trade Reporting Facility (TRF). The role also assists with other aspects of brokerage trade reporting, including the Consolidated Audit Trail (CAT) and Electronic Blue Sheets (EBS). This Transaction Reporting Analyst acts as the first line of defense against reporting breaks before the U.S. core trading day begins. This role works cross-functionally with Brokerage Operations, Compliance, and the U.S.-based Trade Reporting team.

What You’ll Do

  • Monitor TRF and ORF (Trade Reporting Facility) submissions overnight for health, rejections, and out-of-tolerance conditions.
  • Execute the 9:00pm (NYC Time) TRF opening rejection repair process, correcting and resubmitting failed trade reports within FINRA's reporting windows.
  • Review and manage the EBS (Electronic Blue Sheets) submission queue, escalating unresolved items to the U.S. team.
  • Confirm successful completion of CAT (Consolidated Audit Trail) submissions, investigating and escalating failures.
  • Prepare detailed end-of-shift reports summarizing exceptions, open items, and notable activity for the incoming U.S. team.
  • Escalate unresolved or high-severity issues promptly, exercising judgment on when an issue requires immediate U.S. involvement versus next-business-day follow-up.
  • Maintain organized, auditable records of all monitoring activity, repairs, and escalations in line with the firm's written supervisory procedures.
  • Build working familiarity with FINRA/SEC trade reporting rules to identify patterns and recommend process improvements.
  • Partner with Engineering and Brokerage Operations to improve the automation and reliability of overnight monitoring workflows.

You Bring

  • Minimum 2+ years of experience in financial services operations, trade support, or regulatory reporting.
  • Direct exposure to FINRA trade reporting (TRF/CAT/EBS) or equivalent regulatory transaction reporting (e.g., MiFID II or EMIR transaction reporting) is a plus.
  • Ability to work a shift aligned to the U.S. overnight trading session.
  • A track record of ownership and disciplined execution in high-stakes, deadline-driven environments.
  • The ability to prioritize effectively and know when to escalate versus resolve independently.
  • Strong written communication skills — this role's primary deliverable to the U.S. team each day is a clear, accurate handoff report.
  • Impeccable integrity, sound judgment, high attention to detail and a deep respect for risk, controls, and regulatory obligations.
  • Bachelor's degree (or local equivalent post-secondary qualification) in Finance, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following location: Seoul, South Korea - Remote

  • If you're not based in the location listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.

Pay Range: $30,000 – $40,000 USD

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule.
